decision.PASS_NORMAL_MAP01_DEOPT_TRANSFER: candidate escalation exposed >=1 in >=3/4; death/release failure 0 both arms; every candidate final health >=80; candidate coverage >= baseline >=3/4; paired median coverage delta >=2; candidate revisit <= baseline >=3/4
decision.HOLD_NAVIGATION_THREAT_TRADEOFF: safety has no death/release failure but candidate health floor or coverage/exposure gates miss without negative paired median coverage
decision.FAIL_NORMAL_MAP01_DEOPT_TRANSFER: candidate death/release failure, or paired median candidate-minus-baseline coverage <0

claim_boundary: normal MAP01 hazards present, no attack policy/model/recovery cover; not MAP01 clear or combat-controller evidence
